title: Kooky Crunchy Chinese Fish Shui Zhu Yu
description: A winey, crunchy, post-workout Chinese dish featuring milk chocolate, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly Shui Zhu Yu is a unique twist on traditional recipes, air-fried to perfection for a crispy exterior and tender interior. It combines the flavors of China with a sweet and indulgent touch of milk chocolate.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in an air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, whisk together the Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Add the cornstarch to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Air-fry the tofu cubes for 10 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
Melt the milk chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Toss the air-fried tofu cubes with the melted milk chocolate and chopped scallions.
Serve the Kooky Crunchy Chinese Fish Shui Zhu Yu hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
Prepare a side of steamed vegetables or rice to complement the dish.
This recipe is perfect for a post-workout meal or a special occasion.
